name: Ready reckoner rates and stamp duty
title: Maharashtra ready reckoner rates and stamp duty: latest
summary: The government's ready reckoner rates, which set the lowest value stamp duty is paid on, and the stamp duty itself.
means: Stamp duty is worked out on the agreement value or the ready reckoner value, whichever is higher. Ask for the total with stamp duty and registration before you sign.

history.status: There was no ready reckoner rate rise this year; Maharashtra's stamp duty collections are near half of the annual target of Rs 68,500 crore.
